everbright.task: Extract transaction data from China Everbright Bank corporate account statement

column_descriptions.voucher_number: Column 9 - Usually EMPTY. Only bank system voucher numbers belong here. If no content, must be empty string
column_descriptions.memo: Column 10 - Contains transaction descriptions like 'Transfer', 'Loan 21002 xxxxxxx', 'Transfer-Note: xxx', 'Payment' etc. Any descriptive text should go here, NOT in voucher_number column

visual_guidelines.description: Use the black vertical guide lines in the image to determine column boundaries

extraction_rules: WRONG: Putting 'Transfer' or 'Loan xxx' into voucher_number
CORRECT: voucher_number is empty '', memo contains 'Transfer' or 'Loan xxx'
merge_rules: counterparty_account, counterparty_name, memo, serial_number may span multiple lines - must merge vertically
Remove extra spaces caused by line breaks when merging
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

cmb.task: Extract transaction data from China Merchants Bank transaction statement

column_descriptions.debit: 借方(出账) - Outgoing amount. May be EMPTY if transaction is incoming. Located BEFORE credit column.
column_descriptions.credit: 贷方(入账) - Incoming amount. May be EMPTY if transaction is outgoing. Located BETWEEN debit and balance.
column_descriptions.balance: 余额 - Account balance AFTER this transaction. ALWAYS has a value, NEVER empty. Located AFTER credit column. This is the RIGHTMOST of the 3 amount columns.
column_descriptions.card_number: 公司一卡通号 - Company card number. Usually EMPTY or contains short code. Located BEFORE print_instance_id.
column_descriptions.print_instance_id: 打印实例号 - Print instance ID. Contains long alphanumeric code like '536B10xxxxx'. This is the RIGHTMOST column in the entire table.

details: These are 3 consecutive amount columns from left to right: Debit → Credit → Balance
Balance (余额, column 5) ALWAYS has a value - it shows account balance after transaction
Debit (借方, column 3) and Credit (贷方, column 4) are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE - only ONE has value, the other MUST be empty string
COMMON ERROR: When only 2 values appear (e.g., outgoing transaction), the rightmost value is Balance, NOT Credit
Example: If you see values [empty, empty, 6,265,706.93] → debit='', credit='', balance='6,265,706.93'
Example: If you see values [800,052.87, empty, 6,265,706.93] → debit='800,052.87', credit='', balance='6,265,706.93'
Example: If you see values [empty, 800,052.87, 7,065,759.80] → debit='', credit='800,052.87', balance='7,065,759.80'
These are the last 2 columns at the RIGHT edge of the table
card_number (公司一卡通号, column 10) - Usually EMPTY or contains very short value. Located BEFORE print_instance_id.
print_instance_id (打印实例号, column 11) - Contains long alphanumeric codes like '536B10436199', '536B20349777'. This is the RIGHTMOST column.
COMMON ERROR: Putting print_instance_id value into card_number field - AVOID THIS
Rule: If you see a long code like '536Bxxxxxxxx' at the right edge, it belongs to print_instance_id, NOT card_number
If only one value appears in the last 2 columns, check the column position carefully before assignment
Each valid record MUST contain a date in yyyy-MM-dd format in 'transaction_date' field
If a row looks like text (URL like 'http://...' or 'www.cmbchina.com'), even if in first column area, MUST IGNORE - never extract as transaction_id
Blacklist keywords: if content contains '.com', 'http', 'Enquiry', 'aspx', discard the entire row

extraction_rules.rule: Column boundary detection using black guide lines (L1-L10)
details: Left of L1: transaction_id
Between L1-L2: transaction_date (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, merge multi-line)
Between L2-L3: debit (借方/出账) - may be EMPTY
Between L3-L4: credit (贷方/入账) - may be EMPTY, do NOT grab balance from right
Between L4-L5: balance (余额) - ALWAYS has a value, never empty
Between L5-L6: payee_name (merge multi-line)
Between L6-L7: payee_account
Between L7-L8: memo
Between L8-L9: transaction_type
Between L9-L10: card_number (公司一卡通号) - Usually EMPTY, do NOT grab print_instance_id from right
Right of L10: print_instance_id (打印实例号) - Long codes like 536Bxxxxxxxx

noise_filters: URL noise: Force ignore URL strings at top and bottom of page
Footer noise: Never extract page numbers, tips, etc.
merge_rules: payee_name, transaction_id, print_instance_id spanning multiple lines must be merged vertically
stop_conditions: Stop when table end line is detected or invalid row content is encountered
output_constraints: What you see is what you get - ensure data completeness
Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

jining.task: Extract transaction data from Jining Bank corporate current account transaction details

special_format.description: Jining Bank unique format - each transaction spans TWO rows
special_format.row1: seq | transaction_date | channel | income | expense | balance | memo
special_format.row2: Counterparty info (starts with 'Counterparty Info:' containing account and name)

column_descriptions.income: Amount, empty or 0.00 if no data
column_descriptions.expense: Amount, empty or 0.00 if no data
column_descriptions.counterparty_info: Full content from row 2 (remove 'Counterparty Info:' prefix)

extraction_rules: Header row identification: Skip rows containing 'seq', 'transaction_date', 'channel' text
Valid record identification: Must contain both date format (like 2024-06-30) AND amount data
Merge rule: Each record spans 2 rows, row 2's counterparty info MUST be merged with corresponding row 1 record
noise_filters: Ignore page numbers, headers, footers, URLs and other non-transaction data
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

cgb.task: Extract transaction data from China Guangfa Bank account transaction details

column_descriptions.serial_number: Transaction serial number in 8+4 digit format like '76054955 7635'
column_descriptions.income: Income amount, empty or '-' if no data
column_descriptions.expense: Expense amount, empty or '-' if no data
column_descriptions.counterparty_account: Counterparty account number (may span multiple lines)
column_descriptions.counterparty_name: Counterparty name (may span multiple lines) like 'Shandong Laiwei New Materials Co., Ltd'
column_descriptions.counterparty_bank: Counterparty bank name (may span multiple lines)
column_descriptions.memo: Transaction summary like 'Loan Repayment', 'Online Payment', 'General Remittance'

cross_page_handling.description: CGB statements may have records split across pages
cross_page_handling.incomplete_tail: If bottom row lacks complete serial number (8+4 digit format like '80335487 2412') or datetime (like '2024-05-31 17:39:42'), mark as '_incomplete': 'tail'
cross_page_handling.incomplete_head: If first row at top lacks serial number or date, only has time (like '17:39:42') or partial fields, mark as '_incomplete': 'head'
cross_page_handling.complete_record: Complete records do not need '_incomplete' field

merge_rules: serial_number, counterparty_account, counterparty_name, counterparty_bank may span multiple lines - must merge vertically
Remove extra spaces caused by line breaks
extraction_rules: Skip header rows (containing 'serial_number', 'transaction_time' text)
Ignore footer info (like 'Page X of X')
Each transaction record may span multiple lines due to field content
Keep original amount format
IMPORTANT: Ignore electronic seal content - do not extract text from stamps like 'CGB Electronic Receipt Seal'
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

psbc.task: Extract transaction data from Postal Savings Bank of China (PSBC) account statement

column_descriptions.transaction_time: Column 1 - '交易时间'. IMPORTANT: May contain ONLY date (e.g., '2024-12-26') or BOTH date and time (e.g., '2024-12-26 02:10:50'). Extract the FULL content accurately as seen.
column_descriptions.post_date: Column 2 - '记账日期'. Usually a date (e.g., '2024-12-26').
column_descriptions.balance: Column 5 - '余额'. Account balance after transaction.
column_descriptions.serial_number: Column 12 - '交易流水号'. Alphanumeric or numeric code.
column_descriptions.global_route_no: Column 13 - '全局路由号'. Alphanumeric or numeric code.

extraction_rules: Extract data row by row from left to right
For '交易时间', capture the full string (including HH:mm:ss if present)
If an amount column is empty, use empty string ''
Maintain the exact format seen in the image for all fields
merge_rules: Counterparty name or account may span multiple lines - merge vertically
Remove artificial spaces from line breaks during merging
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values

icbc.task: Extract transaction data from Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) account statement

column_descriptions.transaction_time: '交易时间'. Format: 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' (e.g., '2024-06-30 17:07:22'). Must include both date AND time.
column_descriptions.income: '转入金额'. Incoming amount. Format: 'xxx,xxx.xx' with comma separators (e.g., '271,800.00'). Empty if outgoing transaction.
column_descriptions.expense: '转出金额'. Outgoing amount. Format: 'xxx,xxx.xx' with comma separators (e.g., '4,022.97'). Empty if incoming transaction.
column_descriptions.debit_credit: '借贷标志'. Values: '借' for debit (outgoing), '贷' for credit (incoming).
column_descriptions.purpose: '用途'. Transaction purpose (e.g., '5月快递费', '采购款', '转账').

extraction_rules: Transaction time MUST be in 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' format
Amounts MUST keep original format with comma separators (e.g., '271,800.00')
income and expense are mutually exclusive - only one has value per transaction
Skip header rows containing column titles
Ignore footer/page info
output_constraints: Keep original language (Chinese) for extracted values
